fullText.simplified:
孙策

    孙坚没有看刘表，只对自己的军队大声说：“江东就在前面！打完最后这一仗，大家一起回家！”孙坚的军队跟着他一起大声说：“回家！回家！”
    两边的军队打在了一起。
    孙坚的人越来越少，两百，一百，五十，三十……孙坚的声音越来越小，他想杀人，但他累极了，打不动了，他也要死了。他很难过，身边的这些兵是跟着自己出来的，他把他们从江东带出来，但是现在不能带他们回去了。他也很生气，如果自己死了，国宝马上就会被刘表找到。刘表不是好人，国宝被这样的人得到，对国家来说不是好事。
    突然，孙坚听到一个声音：“爸爸！我来了！”
    孙坚马上看过去，是一支几千人的军队！他们骑着马拿着刀，从山的那边跑过来。最前面的那个人很年轻，只有十六七岁，长得很好看。他穿着白衣，骑着白马，跑得最快。
    孙坚的眼睛变大了。他看清楚了，这个年轻人是他的大儿子——孙策。
    孙坚身边的三十几个人也看清楚了，他们高兴地大笑：“是江东的军队！我们不会死了！”
    江东的军队跑过来，帮着孙坚打刘表的军队。孙坚是江东最厉害的人，他的大儿子孙策虽然还很年轻，但也很厉害。他们一起打刘表，刘表的军队很快就乱了。后来刘表败了，他带着一些人跑了。
    孙策还想跟过去杀刘表，孙坚说：“今天我们先回去，以后一定有机会杀他。”
    孙策看着孙坚和孙坚身后三十几个人，虽然他们都在笑，但也累极了。孙策点头说：“好的，爸爸，我们回家。”
    就这样，孙坚终于回到了江东。但孙坚知道，刘表不会放过他；刘表也知道，孙坚还会再来。
fullText.traditional:
孫策

    孫堅沒有看劉表，只對自己的軍隊大聲說：“江東就在前面！打完最後這一仗，大家一起回家！”孫堅的軍隊跟著他一起大聲說：“回家！回家！”
    兩邊的軍隊打在了一起。
    孫堅的人越來越少，兩百，一百，五十，三十……孫堅的聲音越來越小，他想殺人，但他累極了，打不動了，他也要死了。他很難過，身邊的這些兵是跟著自己出來的，他把他們從江東帶出來，但是現在不能帶他們回去了。他也很生氣，如果自己死了，國寶馬上就會被劉表找到。劉表不是好人，國寶被這樣的人得到，對國家來說不是好事。
    突然，孫堅聽到一個聲音：“爸爸！我來了！”
    孫堅馬上看過去，是一支幾千人的軍隊！他們騎著馬拿著刀，從山的那邊跑過來。最前面的那個人很年輕，只有十六七歲，長得很好看。他穿著白衣，騎著白馬，跑得最快。
    孫堅的眼睛變大了。他看清楚了，這個年輕人是他的大兒子——孫策。
    孫堅身邊的三十幾個人也看清楚了，他們高興地大笑：“是江東的軍隊！我們不會死了！”
    江東的軍隊跑過來，幫著孫堅打劉表的軍隊。孫堅是江東最厲害的人，他的大兒子孫策雖然還很年輕，但也很厲害。他們一起打劉表，劉表的軍隊很快就亂了。後來劉表敗了，他帶著一些人跑了。
    孫策還想跟過去殺劉表，孫堅說：“今天我們先回去，以後一定有機會殺他。”
    孫策看著孫堅和孫堅身後三十幾個人，雖然他們都在笑，但也累極了。孫策點頭說：“好的，爸爸，我們回家。”
    就這樣，孫堅終於回到了江東。但孫堅知道，劉表不會放過他；劉表也知道，孫堅還會再來。

sentences.traditional: 孫堅沒有看劉表，只對自己的軍隊大聲說：“江東就在前面！
sentences.pinyin: sūn jiān méi yǒu kàn liú biǎo zhǐ duì zì jǐ de jūn duì dà shēng shuō jiāng dōng jiù zài qián miàn
sentences.english: Sun Jian did not look at Liu Biao. He only said loudly to his troops, “Jiangdong is right ahead!

sentences.simplified: 打完最后这一仗，大家一起回家！”
sentences.traditional: 打完最後這一仗，大家一起回家！”
sentences.pinyin: dǎ wán zuì hòu zhè yí zhàng dà jiā yì qǐ huí jiā
sentences.english: After this final battle, we will all return home together!”

sentences.simplified: 孙坚的军队跟着他一起大声说：“回家！回家！”
sentences.traditional: 孫堅的軍隊跟著他一起大聲說：“回家！回家！”
sentences.pinyin: sūn jiān de jūn duì gēn zhe tā yì qǐ dà shēng shuō huí jiā huí jiā
sentences.english: Sun Jian’s troops said loudly along with him, “Return home! Return home!”

sentences.simplified: 两边的军队打在了一起。
sentences.traditional: 兩邊的軍隊打在了一起。
sentences.pinyin: liǎng biān de jūn duì dǎ zài le yì qǐ
sentences.english: The troops on both sides began to fight.

sentences.simplified: 孙坚的人越来越少，两百，一百，五十，三十……
sentences.traditional: 孫堅的人越來越少，兩百，一百，五十，三十……
sentences.pinyin: sūn jiān de rén yuè lái yuè shǎo liǎng bǎi yì bǎi wǔ shí sān shí
sentences.english: Sun Jian’s men became fewer and fewer: 200, 100, 50, 30 ...

sentences.simplified: 孙坚的声音越来越小，
sentences.traditional: 孫堅的聲音越來越小，
sentences.pinyin: sūn jiān de shēng yīn yuè lái yuè xiǎo
sentences.english: Sun Jian’s voice became softer and softer.

sentences.simplified: 他想杀人，但他累极了，打不动了，他也要死了。
sentences.traditional: 他想殺人，但他累極了，打不動了，他也要死了。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng shā rén dàn tā lèi jí le dǎ bú dòng le tā yě yào sǐ le
sentences.english: He wanted to kill, but he was too tired to fight. He was also about to die.

sentences.simplified: 他很难过，身边的这些兵是跟着自己出来的，
sentences.traditional: 他很難過，身邊的這些兵是跟著自己出來的，
sentences.pinyin: tā hěn nán guò shēn biān de zhè xiē bīng shì gēn zhe zì jǐ chū lái de
sentences.english: He was very sad because the soldiers beside him had followed him here.

sentences.simplified: 他把他们从江东带出来，但是现在不能带他们回去了。
sentences.traditional: 他把他們從江東帶出來，但是現在不能帶他們回去了。
sentences.pinyin: tā bǎ tā men cóng jiāng dōng dài chu lai dàn shì xiàn zài bù néng dài tā men huí qù le
sentences.english: He brought them out of Jiangdong, but now he couldn’t take them back.

sentences.simplified: 他也很生气，如果自己死了，国宝马上就会被刘表找到。
sentences.traditional: 他也很生氣，如果自己死了，國寶馬上就會被劉表找到。
sentences.pinyin: tā yě hěn shēng qì rú guǒ zì jǐ sǐ le guó bǎo mǎ shàng jiù huì bèi liú biǎo zhǎo dào
sentences.english: He was also very angry, because if he died, then the national treasure would be found by Liu Biao right away.

sentences.simplified: 刘表不是好人，国宝被这样的人得到，对国家来说不是好事。
sentences.traditional: 劉表不是好人，國寶被這樣的人得到，對國家來說不是好事。
sentences.pinyin: liú biǎo bú shì hǎo rén guó bǎo bèi zhè yàng de rén dé dào duì guó jiā lái shuō bú shì hǎo shì
sentences.english: Liu Biao was not a good person, and it would not be good for the country for such a person to obtain the national treasure.

sentences.simplified: 突然，孙坚听到一个声音：“爸爸！我来了！”
sentences.traditional: 突然，孫堅聽到一個聲音：“爸爸！我來了！”
sentences.pinyin: tū rán sūn jiān tīng dào yí ge shēng yīn bà ba wǒ lái le
sentences.english: Suddenly, Sun Jian heard a voice, “Father! I’m coming!”

sentences.simplified: 孙坚马上看过去，是一支几千人的军队！
sentences.traditional: 孫堅馬上看過去，是一支幾千人的軍隊！
sentences.pinyin: sūn jiān mǎ shàng kàn guò qu shì yì zhī jǐ qiān rén de jūn duì
sentences.english: Sun Jian looked over immediately. It was an army of several thousand men!

sentences.simplified: 他们骑着马拿着刀，从山的那边跑过来。
sentences.traditional: 他們騎著馬拿著刀，從山的那邊跑過來。
sentences.pinyin: tā men qí zhe mǎ ná zhe dāo cóng shān de nà bian pǎo guò lái
sentences.english: They rode on horseback, held swords in their hands, and came running from the other side of the mountain.

sentences.simplified: 最前面的那个人很年轻，只有十六七岁，长得很好看。
sentences.traditional: 最前面的那個人很年輕，只有十六七歲，長得很好看。
sentences.pinyin: zuì qián miàn de nà ge rén hěn nián qīng zhǐ yǒu shí liù qī suì zhǎng de hěn hǎo kàn
sentences.english: The man at the very front was very young, only 16 or 17 years of age. He was very good-looking.

sentences.simplified: 他穿着白衣，骑着白马，跑得最快。
sentences.traditional: 他穿著白衣，騎著白馬，跑得最快。
sentences.pinyin: tā chuān zhe bái yī qí zhe bái mǎ pǎo de zuì kuài
sentences.english: He was dressed in white and rode a white horse. He was the fastest.

sentences.simplified: 孙坚的眼睛变大了。他看清楚了，这个年轻人是他的大儿子——孙策。
sentences.traditional: 孫堅的眼睛變大了。他看清楚了，這個年輕人是他的大兒子——孫策。
sentences.pinyin: sūn jiān de yǎn jing biàn dà le tā kàn qīng chu le zhè ge nián qīng rén shì tā de dà ér zi sūn cè
sentences.english: Sun Jian’s eyes widened. He saw clearly now, that this young man was his eldest son—Sun Ce.

sentences.simplified: 孙坚身边的三十几个人也看清楚了，
sentences.traditional: 孫堅身邊的三十幾個人也看清楚了，
sentences.pinyin: sūn jiān shēn biān de sān shí jǐ ge rén yě kàn qīng chu le
sentences.english: The 30 or so men beside Sun Jian also saw clearly.

sentences.simplified: 他们高兴地大笑：“是江东的军队！我们不会死了！”
sentences.traditional: 他們高興地大笑：“是江東的軍隊！我們不會死了！”
sentences.pinyin: tā men gāo xìng de dà xiào shì jiāng dōng de jūn duì wǒ men bú huì sǐ le
sentences.english: They laughed happily: “It’s Jiangdong’s troops! We’re not going to die anymore!”

sentences.simplified: 江东的军队跑过来，帮着孙坚打刘表的军队。
sentences.traditional: 江東的軍隊跑過來，幫著孫堅打劉表的軍隊。
sentences.pinyin: jiāng dōng de jūn duì pǎo guò lái bāng zhe sūn jiān dǎ liú biǎo de jūn duì
sentences.english: Jiangdong’s troops ran over and helped Sun Jian fight Liu Biao’s army.

sentences.simplified: 孙坚是江东最厉害的人，
sentences.traditional: 孫堅是江東最厲害的人，
sentences.pinyin: sūn jiān shì jiāng dōng zuì lì hai de rén
sentences.english: Sun Jian was the most formidable person in Jiangdong.

sentences.simplified: 他的大儿子孙策虽然还很年轻，但也很厉害。
sentences.traditional: 他的大兒子孫策雖然還很年輕，但也很厲害。
sentences.pinyin: tā de dà ér zi sūn cè suī rán hái hěn nián qīng dàn yě hěn lì hai
sentences.english: Although his eldest son Sun Ce was still very young, he was also very formidable.

sentences.simplified: 他们一起打刘表，刘表的军队很快就乱了。
sentences.traditional: 他們一起打劉表，劉表的軍隊很快就亂了。
sentences.pinyin: tā men yì qǐ dǎ liú biǎo liú biǎo de jūn duì hěn kuài jiù luàn le
sentences.english: Together they fought Liu Biao. Liu Biao’s troops were soon in disarray.

sentences.simplified: 后来刘表败了，他带着一些人跑了。
sentences.traditional: 後來劉表敗了，他帶著一些人跑了。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái liú biǎo bài le tā dài zhe yì xiē rén pǎo le
sentences.english: Subsequently, Liu Biao was defeated, and he fled with some men.

sentences.simplified: 孙策还想跟过去杀刘表，
sentences.traditional: 孫策還想跟過去殺劉表，
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè hái xiǎng gēn guò qu shā liú biǎo
sentences.english: Sun Ce still wanted to follow Liu Biao and kill him.

sentences.simplified: 孙坚说：“今天我们先回去，以后一定有机会杀他。”
sentences.traditional: 孫堅說：“今天我們先回去，以後一定有機會殺他。”
sentences.pinyin: sūn jiān shuō jīn tiān wǒ men xiān huí qù yǐ hòu yí dìng yǒu jī huì shā tā
sentences.english: Sun Jian said, “Let’s go back home today. There will definitely be a chance to kill him later.”

sentences.simplified: 孙策看着孙坚和孙坚身后三十几个人，
sentences.traditional: 孫策看著孫堅和孫堅身後三十幾個人，
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè kàn zhe sūn jiān hé sūn jiān shēn hòu sān shí jǐ ge rén
sentences.english: Sun Ce looked at Sun Jian and the 30 or so men standing behind him.

sentences.simplified: 虽然他们都在笑，但也累极了。
sentences.traditional: 雖然他們都在笑，但也累極了。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán tā men dōu zài xiào dàn yě lèi jí le
sentences.english: Even though they were all smiling, they were all exhausted.

sentences.simplified: 孙策点头说：“好的，爸爸，我们回家。”
sentences.traditional: 孫策點頭說：“好的，爸爸，我們回家。”
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè diǎn tóu shuō hǎo de bà ba wǒ men huí jiā
sentences.english: Sun Ce nodded and said, “Okay, father, let’s go home.”

sentences.simplified: 就这样，孙坚终于回到了江东。
sentences.traditional: 就這樣，孫堅終於回到了江東。
sentences.pinyin: jiù zhè yàng sūn jiān zhōng yú huí dào le jiāng dōng
sentences.english: Just like that, Sun Jian finally returned to Jiangdong.

sentences.simplified: 但孙坚知道，刘表不会放过他；刘表也知道，孙坚还会再来。
sentences.traditional: 但孫堅知道，劉表不會放過他；劉表也知道，孫堅還會再來。
sentences.pinyin: dàn sūn jiān zhī dào liú biǎo bú huì fàng guò tā liú biǎo yě zhī dào sūn jiān hái huì zài lái
sentences.english: But Sun Jian knew that Liu Biao would not let him off the hook. Liu Biao also knew that Sun Jian would come again.

sentence_translations: Sun Ce
Sun Jian did not look at Liu Biao. He only said loudly to his troops, “Jiangdong is right ahead!
After this final battle, we will all return home together!”
Sun Jian’s troops said loudly along with him, “Return home! Return home!”
The troops on both sides began to fight.
Sun Jian’s men became fewer and fewer: 200, 100, 50, 30 ...
Sun Jian’s voice became softer and softer.
He wanted to kill, but he was too tired to fight. He was also about to die.
He was very sad because the soldiers beside him had followed him here.
He brought them out of Jiangdong, but now he couldn’t take them back.
He was also very angry, because if he died, then the national treasure would be found by Liu Biao right away.
Liu Biao was not a good person, and it would not be good for the country for such a person to obtain the national treasure.
Suddenly, Sun Jian heard a voice, “Father! I’m coming!”
Sun Jian looked over immediately. It was an army of several thousand men!
They rode on horseback, held swords in their hands, and came running from the other side of the mountain.
The man at the very front was very young, only 16 or 17 years of age. He was very good-looking.
He was dressed in white and rode a white horse. He was the fastest.
Sun Jian’s eyes widened. He saw clearly now, that this young man was his eldest son—Sun Ce.
The 30 or so men beside Sun Jian also saw clearly.
They laughed happily: “It’s Jiangdong’s troops! We’re not going to die anymore!”
Jiangdong’s troops ran over and helped Sun Jian fight Liu Biao’s army.
Sun Jian was the most formidable person in Jiangdong.
Although his eldest son Sun Ce was still very young, he was also very formidable.
Together they fought Liu Biao. Liu Biao’s troops were soon in disarray.
Subsequently, Liu Biao was defeated, and he fled with some men.
Sun Ce still wanted to follow Liu Biao and kill him.
Sun Jian said, “Let’s go back home today. There will definitely be a chance to kill him later.”
Sun Ce looked at Sun Jian and the 30 or so men standing behind him.
Even though they were all smiling, they were all exhausted.
Sun Ce nodded and said, “Okay, father, let’s go home.”
Just like that, Sun Jian finally returned to Jiangdong.
But Sun Jian knew that Liu Biao would not let him off the hook. Liu Biao also knew that Sun Jian would come again.
